product_one_liner.value: Axure RP lets UX professionals, business analysts, and product managers create realistic interactive software prototypes without coding, then share them for feedback and developer handoff.

employee_band.notes: The profile reports 17 employees as of September 30, 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains product announcements, tutorials, customer stories, and company/security updates, rather than two engineer-authored accounts of how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes getting-started material, reference articles, and tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A historical Product Support Specialist posting is readable, but the careers index could not be read and no current complete role list could be established; no live qualifying AI/ML posting was verified.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model/provider was disclosed in the product/MCP documentation, AI-chat announcement, security page, privacy policy, or subprocessor list reviewed; supported external AI clients are not evidence of an embedded model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the explicitly named certifications. Separately, Axure claims GDPR compliance and PCI compliance for transmitting credit-card information; PCI DSS Level 1 is attributed to its third-party payment processor, not an Axure-wide certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest identified financing was a PPP loan approved April 13, 2020, subsequently forgiven—not a venture-equity round. Owler lists this as its latest funding event; the SBA-derived record gives the exact amount. Tracxn separately classifies Axure as unfunded.

raised_18mo.notes: For May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026: the latest listed financing is the April 2020 PPP loan; the November 2026 company profile reports no funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The historical support-role posting does not establish the complete current hiring roster, and the careers index could not be read; no live qualifying sales-development or account-executive posting was verified.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 24, 2026, Axure introduced the Axure RP MCP server in alpha, giving AI tools read-only access to open RP files for code generation, analysis, and documentation; this falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated qualifying C-level/VP change was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The company page provides no complete leadership roster with start dates, so absence of a change cannot be established.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list identifies HubSpot for email marketing and analytics and Mailchimp for email marketing.
